verdict.rationale: Notte documents a public REST-style API with Bearer token authentication (notte-docs-17), API endpoints for deployment/scheduling (notte-docs-2), and a full CLI/SDK plus MCP server for agent-driven control (notte-docs-7, notte-docs-9, notte-probe-3, notte-probe-4). This is squarely an API-first product built for AI-native/agentic consumption. missing for 10: no discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (404s on all standard paths per notte-probe-2), and no independent third-party confirmation of API reliability beyond vendor docs.
